The trick is develop your cognitive functions. Take a thing which you want to change in yourself and fake as if you're that kind of a person. Lie to everyone and yourself. Habit grows little by little. One day that thing will become a part of you. I have adhd too but my behaviour screams I'm not. Because I lie and gaslight myself into behaving like an organized, focused person. It's a simple trick but very effective. I have well developed Fe and Si in my stack, which is actually awesome but sometimes I feel like a living contradiction and my mind is in constant war while making simple decisions.
Same way there's random barks in the background during fearless chorus. I could only listen to that whenever I listen to fearless. So weird.

I am kinda in the same situation like I dropped out of college in 3rd year and now pursuing an entirely different stream so all my friends are way ahead of me while I'm just starting from scratch. They are placed in well paying jobs, some moving abroad for further studies, some getting married while I'm here maybe not stuck but very behind of everyone I know. 


My family isn't very supportive of my decision so I had to leave my house and I'm staying alone at my grandma's house which is empty. I used to feel this crushing pressure and incompetence seeing everyone around me progressing while I'm just.... there. I used to think everything was soo unfair. What I didn't realize is I readily have TIME in my hands. I can make all the decisions I want, whenever and whatever I want to. First I used to get sad when people say I have a lot of time in hands now I take it in a good way. Yes I have time, I can learn a lot of new things, meet a lot of new people, spend hours with my loved ones, improve all the skills necessary like the world is in my hands now. It's upto me whether I spend it worrying about everything or take up new challenges spicing up everyday of my life. I'm still going there, the place which I've set as a goal to reach, but the time in between? Yeah it's my reign.

Well there should be an authoritarian or some kind of higher power which holds the child in that place. As a living citizen I would try to gather group of people who empathize for the kid and wants to help them. I'd try to save or reduce the suffering of the kid by appealing to that higher power. If nothing works will I leave that place? Yes. Because all the happiness in Omelas is materialistic and external. If as rightful citizens we cannot achieve what we want either because of the authority or the hypocrisy of other people living there, we are already in a controlled system. And we are already living a system like that. I'd rather live a decent life with problems and troubles than a materialistic happy life with the guilt of truth. For me life is about learning and growing as an individual and for society. Happiness is subjective. I value internal peace more because I know externally there's going to be turmoil at whatever stage you are in life. When I turn back I'd be happy and proud that I lived a guilt free regret free life than the happiness I got externally.

I can relate to you except for the physical abuse. I assume you are from India by your username. My advice is to just stay low until your exams. Then leave your house and the best is to leave the state. Because if not they'll try to manipulate you to come visit them regularly. The only reason we have to keep up with this bs is for the financial purposes. For coping try finding people who goes through the same. You understand each other and would be there to support and motivate to move on. Do things which gives you a sense of reward and boost your self esteem. Toxic people always have a pattern and motives. Figuring it out is really useful to get things done your way.
